[Thinking]
**Proposing streamer dashboard design**

I want to propose design ideas for a better Twitch streamer dashboard. First, I'll ask questions to gather requirements, then suggest a structured approach focusing on persona creation, goals, key metrics, and information architecture. 

I'll outline a layout wireframe covering components like real-time states, notifications, and accessibility. Offering actionable recommendations, I can provide a description of a low-fidelity mockup and prioritize a roadmap for MVP versus advanced features. I aim to start with clarifying questions while considering mid-sized streamer needs and key workflows.**Designing streamer dashboard features**

I’m thinking about enhancements for a streamer dashboard. I should include customization options like profiles for each game and integration with OBS or Streamlabs. It would be great to embed OBS controls, manage latency, and monitor resource usage. I want to consider privacy modes for safe streaming, monetization options like ad management, and community features such as loyalty points. Stream health metrics are crucial, as well as VOD and clip management, safety features, and integrations for music libraries. Finally, ensuring accessibility and internationalization will be vital in the design.**Proposing wireframes and components**

I need to propose wireframes that include a detailed description of components, event flows, and an alerts taxonomy. It's also important to outline key user journeys clearly. While aiming for conciseness, I want to ensure this is comprehensive enough to cover all the essential aspects. Additionally, I should identify MVP milestones for effective implementation. Balancing these elements will help create a solid foundation for the design process. Let's get to work!
[/Thinking]

Awesome—happy to help. To give you a design you can actually ship, I’ll outline a practical, modular dashboard tailored to streamers’ real workflows, with layouts, components, and a roadmap. If you share your target audience (new vs. pro streamers), platform constraints (web/desktop/mobile), and integration preferences (OBS/Streamlabs/own encoder), I can tailor it further and sketch UI states.

Assumptions for this proposal
- Platform: Web app (desktop-first), companion mobile app.
- Target: Small-to-mid streamers (concurrent 20–2,000), but scalable for partners.
- Integrations: OBS via WebSocket, Twitch EventSub + PubSub, Chat (IRC), Extensions, StreamElements/Streamlabs optional.

Primary jobs-to-be-done (JTBD)
1) Start stream confidently: check tech, titles/tags, scenes, audio, ingest, ads, safety.
2) Monitor at a glance: stream health, viewers/follows/subs, chat velocity/sentiment, alerts.
3) Moderate without friction: AutoMod queue, suspicious users, raids, link spam, slow/followers-only toggles.
4) Manage engagement: channel points queue, predictions, polls, shoutouts, raids, guests.
5) Monetize live: subs/gifts, bits, goals, sponsor deliverables, ad scheduling with guardrails.
6) Capture content: markers, clips, replay, highlights, chat-to-clip context.
7) Collaborate: guest audio/video, Discord stage, collab alerts.
8) End and review: quick analytics, VOD tasks, thank-you messages.

Information architecture
- Global top bar: Live status, scene indicator, mic/desktop mute, DND toggle, stream timer, Go Live/End, command palette (⌘K) for quick actions.
- Left nav: Dashboard, Go Live Setup, Live, Moderation, Engagement, Monetization, Content, Analytics, Settings, Integrations.
- Right “Action Rail”: Contextual quick actions (raid, shoutout, slow/followers-only, ad start/snooze).
- Dockable Panels: All modules can be rearranged, resized, popped out, or saved as layouts per game/category.

Default live layout (three-column, second-monitor friendly)
- Left column (Control stack):
  - Scenes & Sources: OBS scenes list + transition controls; source visibility toggles.
  - Audio Mixer: VU meters, gating/compressor indicators, quick solo/mute, monitoring toggle.
  - Stream Health: Bitrate, dropped frames, CPU/GPU, encoder, ingest health, latency; traffic-light severity; “Run network test.”
- Center (Signal + Chat):
  - Program Preview: Low-CPU confidence preview with safe-region overlay; Realtime marker button; Replay buffer “Save last 30s.”
  - Chat & Moderation Lane: Unified chat with inline mod actions; chat filters (subs, VIPs, first-time), sentiment sparkline, message velocity, automod queue tabs.
- Right column (Engagement & Revenue):
  - Alerts & Events: Timeline of follows, subs, bits, raids, goals; acknowledge/snooze; on-stream alert test.
  - Channel Points Queue: Redeems with quick fulfill/deny, cooldowns, throttling.
  - Polls/Predictions: Create/manage; outcomes; automate refund on crash.
  - Monetization: Sub/bits goals, ad scheduler with safe windows, sponsor checklist (deliverables with timers).
  - Guests: Invite link, greenroom status, audio routing, quick crop, layout presets.

Key panels and behaviors
- Go Live Setup (preflight):
  - Stream info: Title, category, tags, language, stream marker template, content warnings.
  - Tech check: Mic level, desktop audio, webcam, encoder target bitrate, ingest selection with recommendation, network test result.
  - Scenes sanity: First scene preview, sources present, mic routing correct.
  - Safety defaults: Followers-only/slow mode presets, banned phrase list snapshot, AutoMod level, shield mode hotkey.
  - Save as preset per game/category; schedule start; tweet/Discord announce.
- Moderation command center:
  - AutoMod queue with reason highlights, model-predicted severity, one-tap allow/deny and teach.
  - Suspicious users feed (likely evaders/raiders): shadowban, restricted mode, follow-to-chat toggle.
  - Raid shield: automatic when large raid difference; adjustable thresholds; raid message-only chat for X minutes.
  - History lookup: user card with prior bans/timeouts/clips, notes, shared ban lists (opt-in).
- Engagement tools:
  - Shoutouts: Search or from recent chatters/raiders, on-stream overlay, link copy.
  - Hype orchestration: One-tap goal prompts, milestone alerts, emote-only celebration.
  - Triggers: If-viewers>threshold OR subs>goal THEN run “Thank You scene” macro (configurable).
- Content capture:
  - Clip panel with rolling buffer and auto-suggested clip moments (based on chat spikes, alerts, volume peaks).
  - Marker templates: “Boss kill,” “Funny moment,” tagged for highlights.
  - Highlight builder after stream: auto-assemble suggested segments with chat overlay preview.
- Stream health details:
  - Deep diagnostics on click: per-minute bitrate, RTMP retry log, encoder queue, frames missed, top dropped frame reasons.
  - Guidance: recommended fixes (lower B-frames, adaptive bitrate, change ingest) with safe-apply presets.
- Ads with guardrails:
  - Scheduler that respects “avoid ads within 30s of alerts/polls/raids.”
  - Auto-snooze if conversation velocity high; post-ad summary; revenue estimate.
  - Manual 30/60/90s with remaining pre-roll off timer and a “Countdown lower-third” toggle.

Customization and layouts
- Layout profiles: “Chill,” “High-action,” “Collab,” “Tournament,” switchable by hotkey or auto by game.
- Safe-on-stream mode: Hides revenue numbers, private messages, viewer list; uses pseudonyms for mods; on-boarding explains privacy.
- Command palette: Start ad, toggle slow, shoutout, set marker, run scene macro, start prediction, enable shield.

Mobile companion (second screen)
- Quick actions: Run ads, shoutouts, shield, slow/followers-only.
- Alerts + chat lite with moderation swipes.
- IRL: Start/stop mobile stream, bitrate/heat warnings, path-loss precheck.

Notifications and alerting model
- Severity: Critical (red) stream failures; Important (amber) raids/high-priority mod queue; Normal (purple) follows/subs; Silent for info.
- Batching: Combine low-value alerts to avoid spam; “Focus mode” mutes non-critical during boss fights.
- Sound/vibration themes with ducking option.

Accessibility
- High-contrast and colorblind-safe palettes.
- Scalable UI (90–130%).
- Full keyboard nav, screen reader labels, ARIA for live regions.
- Caption monitor for your stream and guest audio tracks.

Performance and reliability
- Low-CPU preview option; GPU decoding toggle.
- WebSocket-first updates (EventSub, PubSub) with offline queue and replay.
- Graceful degradation when Twitch APIs throttle; local cache for critical buttons (mute/scene).

Integrations and APIs
- Twitch: EventSub WebSocket (stream.online/offline, channel.* events), Chat IRC, PubSub (points), Helix for metadata, Ads API.
- OBS: obs-websocket for scenes/sources/mixer; user-guided pairing with status.
- StreamElements/Streamlabs: optional alerts sync and overlays management.
- Discord: announcements and stage presence.
- Music: DMCA-safe “now playing” and auto-duck music during ad breaks.

Security and privacy
- OAuth2 with PKCE, least-privilege scopes per feature, secure token vault, per-scene “redact overlays” toggle.
- Stream-safe screenshots redact private data automatically.

Analytics (live + post)
- Live: viewers, chatters, chat sentiment, unique chatters/min, sub/bits momentum, source of viewers (raid/browse/followers), churn risk indicator.
- Post: funnel (impressions→clicks→watch), heatmap of chat spikes vs. clips vs. alerts, comparative performance to last 5 streams.
- Actionables: suggestions like “Your predictions increased retention +7%—reuse around minute 20.”

Roadmap
- MVP (4–6 weeks):
  - Go Live Setup, basic Live layout (Preview, Chat, Events), Stream Health lite, Channel Points queue, Ads manual, Markers/Clips basic, Mod actions (ban/timeout/delete), Shield toggle, Layout save.
  - Integrations: EventSub, IRC chat, OBS WebSocket basic.
- v1.1:
  - Auto-suggested clips, poll/predictions, ad scheduler with guardrails, suspicious users, shoutouts, replay buffer save, network test.
- v1.2:
  - Guests, sponsor checklist, automation triggers, deep diagnostics, analytics live panel, mobile companion.
- v2.0:
  - Collaborative dashboards for mods/managers, highlight builder, scene macros, A/B testing of alerts, extension hooks.

Low-fidelity wireframe description (for handoff)
- Header: [LIVE • 01:12:34] [Scene: Gameplay] [Mic: -18 dB | Desktop: -12 dB] [DND Off] [⌘K]
- Left pane (25% width): Scenes list (Current highlighted) -> Sources (eye toggles) -> Mixer (VU + mute/solo) -> Stream Health card (bitrate 6000 kbps, 0.3% dropped, amber if >1%)
- Center pane (50%): Preview (top, 16:9) with marker + replay buttons; Chat (bottom) with tabs: All | Mods | AutoMod; Input with canned replies and emotes
- Right pane (25%): Events feed (cards with icons) -> Points Queue (redeem cards with fulfill/deny) -> Polls/Predictions (create/manage) -> Monetization (goal bar + Ad start/snooze)

Next steps
- Tell me:
  - Your target streamer tier and must-have integrations.
  - Desktop-only or also mobile companion.
  - Any brand guidelines or constraints.
- I can then:
  - Produce clickable wireframes for 2–3 key screens.
  - Draft the data flow/API calls and WebSocket event handling.
  - Define the design system tokens (color/typography/spacing) and accessibility checklist.
  - Create a prioritized backlog with user stories and acceptance criteria.
